collect_queued: The endpoint is offline. The collection is queued and will run on its next report.
collect_dispatched: Collection dispatched. Waiting for the agent to report a new snapshot...
collect_timeout: The endpoint accepted the collection but has not reported a new snapshot yet. It may be offline, or the agent may still be scanning. Use Collect Inventory again later.
still_detected: Uninstall finished, but "{name}" was still detected in device inventory. Software may still be present on endpoint.
removed: "{name}" was successfully removed from device inventory.
uninstall_running: Uninstall request for "{name}" sent to {hostname}. Running silent uninstaller...
uninstall_still_running: Uninstall request for "{name}" is still executing on {hostname}. Use Collect Inventory to refresh the software list once completed.
uninstall_query_failed: Failed to query uninstall status for "{name}".
snapshot_when_stale: {time} ({age} — this list may be out of date)
loading: Loading device telemetry and inventory snapshot...
no_snapshot: No inventory snapshot has been received from this device yet.
domain_unknown_hint: This agent does not report domain membership yet; update it to see this.
confirm_switches: The agent works out the silent uninstall switches from the endpoint itself. If the program records no verifiable silent command, the request is refused and nothing is run -- no window ever opens on the endpoint.
confirm_not_removal: This sends a request. It does not confirm removal: the agent can still refuse once it receives it. Use Collect Inventory afterwards to collect a new inventory -- the row disappears only if the program really was removed.
